question_tet: Saida mak ó-nia kunsola mesak ida de'it iha moris no iha mate?
question_en: What is your only comfort in life and death?
answer_tet: Katak ha'u la'ós ha'u-nia an rasik nian, maibé ho isin no klamar, iha moris no iha mate, ha'u pertense ba ha'u-nia Salvadór laran-metin Jesuis Kristu. Nia selu hotu tiha ona ha'u-nia sala hotu-hotu ho Ninia ran ne'ebé folin-boot, no liberta tiha ona ha'u hosi diabu nia podér hotu-hotu. Nia mós preserva ha'u ho dalan nune'i to'o laiha fuuk-rahun ida monu hosi ha'u-nia ulun ho la ho ha'u-nia Aman lalehan nian nia hakarak; tebes duni, buat hotu-hotu tenke servisu hamutuk ba ha'u-nia salvasaun. Tan ne'e, liuhosi Ninia Espíritu Santu Nia mós haraik serteza mai ha'u kona-ba moris rohan-la'ek, no halo ha'u ho laran tomak prontu no korafe husi tempu ne'e ba oin atu moris ba Nia.
answer_en: That I am not my own, but belong with body and soul, both in life and in death, to my faithful Savior Jesus Christ. He has fully paid for all my sins with his precious blood, and has set me free from all the power of the devil. He also preserves me in such a way that without the will of my heavenly Father not a hair can fall from my head; indeed, all things must work together for my salvation. Therefore, by his Holy Spirit he also assures me of eternal life and makes me heartily willing and ready from now on to live for him.

question_tet: Buat hira mak ó tenke hatene atu moris no mate iha ksolok hosi kunsola ne'e?
question_en: What do you need to know in order to live and die in the joy of this comfort?
answer_tet: Buat tolu: dahuluk, oinsá boot ha'u-nia sala no mizeria; daruak, oinsá ha'u hetan liberta hosi ha'u-nia sala no mizeria hotu-hotu; datolu, oinsá ha'u tenke fó agradesimentu ba Maromak ba libertasaun nian ne'e.
answer_en: Three: first, how great my sins and misery are; second, how I am delivered from all my sins and misery; third, how I am to be thankful to God for such deliverance.

question_tet: Hosi ne'ebé mak ó hatene ó-nia sala no mizeria?
question_en: From where do you know your sins and misery?
answer_tet: Hosi Maromak nia lei.
answer_en: From the law of God.

question_tet: Saida mak Maromak nia lei husu hosi ita?
question_en: What does God's law require of us?
answer_tet: Kristu hanorin ita ne'e iha rezumu ida iha Mateus kapítulu 22: 'Ó tenke hadomi Na'i ó-nia Maromak ho ó-nia laran tomak, ho ó-nia klamar tomak, no ho ó-nia hanoin tomak. Ne'e mak ukun-fuan dahuluk no boot liu. No daruak hanesan ne'e: Ó tenke hadomi ó-nia prosimu hanesan ó-nia an rasik. Lei tomak no Profeta sira sintu iha ukun-fuan rua ne'e nia leten.'
answer_en: Christ teaches us this in a summary in Matthew 22: 'Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind. This is the first and greatest commandment. And the second is like it: Love your neighbor as yourself. All the Law and the Prophets hang on these two commandments.'

question_tet: Ó bele kumpri tomak buat ne'e hotu ho perfeitu ka?
question_en: Can you keep all this perfectly?
answer_tet: Lae, tanba ha'u-nia natureza cenderung atu odiu Maromak no ha'u-nia prosimu.
answer_en: No, for I am prone by nature to hate God and my neighbor.

question_tet: Se nune'i, Maromak kria ema aat no naksobu hanesan ne'e ka?
question_en: Did God, then, create man so wicked and perverse?
answer_tet: Lae, no enkontráriu, Maromak kria ema di'ak no tuir Ninia imajen, ne'e mak iha justisa loloos no santidade, atu nune'i nia bele hatene loloos Maromak Ninia Kriadór, hadomi Nia ho laran tomak, no moris hamutuk ho Nia iha bensaun eternu atu hahi'i no fó glória ba Nia.
answer_en: No, on the contrary, God created man good and in his image, that is, in true righteousness and holiness, so that he might rightly know God his Creator, heartily love him, and live with him in eternal blessedness to praise and glorify him.

question_tet: Hosi ne'ebé mak ema nia natureza naksobu ne'e mai?
question_en: From where, then, did man's depraved nature come?
answer_tet: Hosi monu no desobediénsia hosi ita-nia bei'ala dahuluk sira, Adão no Eva, iha Paraízu; tanba iha ne'ebá ita-nia natureza sai korruptu tebes to'o ita hotu hetan koñsebe no moris iha sala laran.
answer_en: From the fall and disobedience of our first parents, Adam and Eve, in Paradise, for there our nature became so corrupt that we are all conceived and born in sin.

question_tet: Maibé ita korruptu tebes to'o ita la bele ho tomak atu halo di'ak ruma no hali'is ba aat hotu-hotu ka?
question_en: But are we so corrupt that we are totally unable to do any good and inclined to all evil?
answer_tet: Loos, se la'ós ita hetan mós moris foun liuhosi Maromak nia Espíritu.
answer_en: Yes, unless we are regenerated by the Spirit of God.

question_tet: Maibé Maromak la halo injustisa ba ema ka liuhosi husu iha Ninia lei buat ne'ebé ema la bele halo?
question_en: But does not God do man an injustice by requiring in his law what man cannot do?
answer_tet: Lae, tanba Maromak kria ema ho dalan ne'ebé nia kbiit atu halo ne'e. Maibé ema, liuhosi instigasaun diabu nian, iha desobediénsia ho propozitu lakon tiha ba nia an no ninia jerasaun hotu-hotu dom sira-ne'e.
answer_en: No, for God so created man that he was able to do it. But man, at the instigation of the devil, in deliberate disobedience robbed himself and all his descendants of these gifts.

question_tet: Maromak sei husik desobediénsia no mehi soe-an sira-ne'e la hetan kastigu ka?
question_en: Will God allow such disobedience and apostasy to go unpunished?
answer_tet: Certeza lae. Nia la haksolok tebes ho ita-nia pekadu orijinál no mós ita-nia hahalok sala atuál sira. Tan ne'e Nia sei fó kastigu ba sira liuhosi juízu justu iha tempu agora no eternu, hanesan Nia proklama tiha ona: 'Malisan ba ema hotu-hotu ne'ebé la kontinua halo buat hotu-hotu ne'ebé hakerek iha Livru Lei nian.'
answer_en: Certainly not. He is terribly displeased with our original sin as well as our actual sins. Therefore he will punish them by a just judgment both now and eternally, as he has declared: 'Cursed is everyone who does not continue to do everything written in the Book of the Law.'

question_tet: Maromak mós misericordiózu ka lae?
question_en: Is not God also merciful?
answer_tet: Maromak tebes duni misericordiózu, maibé Nia mós justu. Ninia justisa husu katak sala ne'ebé halo hasoru Maromak nia majestade aas liu hotu tenke hetan kastigu ho kastigu ne'ebé todan liu hotu, ne'e mak ho kastigu eternu ba isin no klamar.
answer_en: God is indeed merciful, but he is also just. His justice requires that sin committed against the most high majesty of God also be punished with the most severe, that is, with everlasting, punishment of body and soul.

question_tet: Tanba, tuir Maromak nia juízu justu, ita merese kastigu temporál no eternu, oinsá mak ita bele halai hosi kastigu ne'e no hetan simu fali ba iha Ninia favor?
question_en: Since, according to God's righteous judgment, we deserve temporal and eternal punishment, how can we escape this punishment and be received again into favor?
answer_tet: Maromak husu katak Ninia justisa tenke hetan satisfas. Tan ne'e, tuntutan sira hosi Ninia justisa tenke hetan selu tomak, hosi ita-nia an rasik ka hosi seluk ida.
answer_en: God requires that his justice be satisfied. Therefore the claims of his justice must be paid in full, either by ourselves or by another.

question_tet: Ita bele selu dívida ne'e hosi ita-nia an rasik ka?
question_en: Can we pay this debt ourselves?
answer_tet: Certeza lae. Tuir loloos, ita aumenta ita-nia dívida loron-loron.
answer_en: Certainly not. Actually, we increase our debt every day.

question_tet: Kriatura seluk ruma—kualker ida—bele selu dívida ne'e mai ita ka?
question_en: Can another creature—any at all—pay this debt for us?
answer_tet: Lae. Dahuluk, Maromak sei la fó kastigu ba kriatura seluk ba ema nia kulpa. Liután ne'e, laiha kriatura baibain ne'ebé bele lori Maromak nia hirus eternu nia todan hasoru sala no liberta ema seluk hosi ne'e.
answer_en: No. To begin with, God will not punish another creature for man's guilt. Furthermore, no mere creature can bear the weight of God's eternal wrath against sin and deliver others from it.

question_tet: Mediadór no libertadór kualidade ida ne'ebé mak ita tenke buka se nune'i?
question_en: What kind of mediator and deliverer should we look for then?
answer_tet: Ema ida ne'ebé mak ema loloos no justu, no hala'o podér boot liu kriatura hotu-hotu, ne'e mak ema ida ne'ebé iha tempu hanesan mós Maromak loloos.
answer_en: One who is a true and righteous man, and yet more powerful than all creatures, that is, one who is at the same time true God.

question_tet: Tanba saida mak Nia tenke sai ema loloos no justu?
question_en: Why must he be a true and righteous man?
answer_tet: Tanba Maromak nia justisa husu katak natureza ema nian ne'ebé halo sala tenke selu ba ninia sala; maibé ema sala-la'ek ida la bele selu ba ema seluk sira.
answer_en: Because God's justice requires that the human nature which has sinned must pay for its sin; but a sinner could never pay for others.

question_tet: Tanba saida mak Nia iha tempu hanesan tenke sai Maromak loloos?
question_en: Why must he at the same time be true God?
answer_tet: Atu nune'i, liuhosi podér hosi Ninia divindade, Nia bele lori Maromak nia hirus nia todan iha Ninia mehi humanidade nian no manán mai ita no restaura mai ita justisa no moris.
answer_en: So that, by the power of his divinity, he might bear the weight of God's wrath in his humanity and earn for us and restore to us righteousness and life.

question_tet: Sé mak mediadór ne'e, ne'ebé iha tempu hanesan mak Maromak loloos no ema loloos no justu?
question_en: Who is this mediator, who is at the same time true God and a true and righteous man?
answer_tet: Ita-nia Na'i Jesuis Kristu, ne'ebé hetan fó mai ita atu liberta ita ho tomak no halo ita loos ho Maromak.
answer_en: Our Lord Jesus Christ, who was given to us to set us completely free and to make us right with God.

question_tet: Oinsá mak ó mai hatene buat ne'e?
question_en: How do you come to know this?
answer_tet: Evanjellu santu fó-hatene mai ha'u. Maromak hahuu revelar evanjellu iha Paraízu kedu tiha ona; depoiz, Nia halo profetiza no proklama tiha liuhosi patriarka sira no profeta sira, no hatudu nanis liuhosi sakrifísiu sira no serimónia seluk sira hosi lei; no ikusmai, Nia kumpri tiha nia liuhosi Ninia Oan-Mane doben rasik.
answer_en: The holy gospel tells me. God began to reveal the gospel already in Paradise; later, he had it proclaimed by the patriarchs and prophets, and foreshadowed by the sacrifices and other ceremonies of the law; and finally, he fulfilled it through his own beloved Son.

question_tet: Ema hotu-hotu hetan salvasaun liuhosi Kristu hanesan ema hotu-hotu lakon liuhosi Adão ka?
question_en: Are all men saved through Christ just as all were lost through Adam?
answer_tet: Lae. Ema sira-ne'e de'it mak hetan salvasaun ne'ebé liuhosi fiar loloos hetan foti tama ba Kristu no simu Ninia benefísiu hotu-hotu.
answer_en: No. Only those are saved who by true faith are grafted into Christ and accept all his benefits.

question_tet: Saida mak fiar loloos?
question_en: What is true faith?
answer_tet: Fiar loloos la'ós de'it koñesimentu mehi ida liuhosi ne'ebé ha'u kaer nu'udar lia-loos buat hotu-hotu ne'ebé Maromak revelar tiha mai ita iha Ninia Liafuan, maibé mós konfiansa laran tomak ida, ne'ebé Espíritu Santu servisu iha ha'u-nia laran liuhosi evanjellu, katak la'ós de'it ba ema seluk, maibé mós ba ha'u rasik, perdua sala nian, justisa eternu, no salvasaun hetan fó gratuitamentu hosi Maromak, de'it hosi grasa, de'it tanba Kristu nia mehi sira.
answer_en: True faith is not only a sure knowledge whereby I hold for truth all that God has revealed to us in his Word, but also a hearty trust, which the Holy Spirit works in me by the gospel, that not only to others, but to me also, forgiveness of sins, everlasting righteousness, and salvation are freely given by God, merely of grace, only for the sake of Christ's merits.

question_tet: Saida mak ema kristaun tenke fiar se nune'i?
question_en: What then must a Christian believe?
answer_tet: Buat hotu-hotu ne'ebé hetan mehi prometidu mai ita iha evanjellu, ne'ebé artigu sira hosi ita-nia fiar kristaun katóliku no la duvida nian hanorin ita iha rezumu ida.
answer_en: All that is promised us in the gospel, which the articles of our catholic, undoubted Christian faith teach us in summary.

question_tet: Artigu sira-ne'e mak saida?
question_en: What are these articles?
answer_tet: 1. Ha'u fiar iha Maromak Aman Kbiit-Na'in, Kriadór lalehan no rai nian. 2. No iha Jesuis Kristu Ninia Oan-Mane mesak, ita-nia Na'i; 3. ne'ebé hetan koñsebe liuhosi Espíritu Santu, moris hosi virjem Maria; 4. terus iha Pónsio Pilatos nia okos, hetan kruzifika, mate, no hakoi; Nia tun ba infernu; 5. iha loron terseiru Nia moris hi'as hosi mate; 6. Nia sa'e ba lalehan, no tur iha Maromak Aman Kbiit-Na'in nia liman-kuana; 7. hosi ne'ebá Nia sei mai atu tesi-lia ba ema moris no ema mate sira. 8. Ha'u fiar iha Espíritu Santu; 9. kireja katóliku santu, komuñaun santu sira-nian; 10. perdua sala nian; 11. rezurreisaun isin nian; 12. no moris rohan-la'ek. Ámen.
answer_en: 1. I believe in God the Father Almighty, Maker of heaven and earth. 2. And in Jesus Christ his only begotten Son, our Lord; 3. who was conceived by the Holy Spirit, born of the virgin Mary; 4. suffered under Pontius Pilate, was crucified, dead, and buried; he descended into hell; 5. the third day he rose again from the dead; 6. he ascended into heaven, and sitteth at the right hand of God the Father Almighty; 7. from thence he shall come to judge the living and the dead. 8. I believe in the Holy Spirit; 9. the holy catholic church, the communion of saints; 10. the forgiveness of sins; 11. the resurrection of the body; 12. and the life everlasting. Amen.

question_tet: Oinsá mak artigu sira-ne'e hetan fahe?
question_en: How are these articles divided?
answer_tet: Ba iha parte tolu: dahuluk kona-ba Maromak Aman no ita-nia kriasaun; daruak kona-ba Maromak Oan-Mane no ita-nia redensaun; datolu kona-ba Maromak Espíritu Santu no ita-nia santifikasaun.
answer_en: Into three parts: the first is of God the Father and our creation; the second, of God the Son and our redemption; the third, of God the Holy Spirit and our sanctification.

question_tet: Tanba iha Maromak ida mesak de'it, tanba saida mak ó ko'alia kona-ba pessoa tolu: Aman, Oan, no Espíritu Santu?
question_en: Since there is only one God, why do you speak of three: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit?
answer_tet: Tanba Maromak revelar tiha Ninia an nune'i iha Ninia Liafuan, katak pessoa ketak tolu ne'e mak Maromak ida mesak, loloos, no eternu.
answer_en: Because God has so revealed himself in his Word, that these three distinct persons are the one, true, eternal God.

question_tet: Saida mak ó fiar bainhira ó dehan: "Ha'u fiar iha Maromak Aman Kbiit-Na'in, Kriadór lalehan no rai nian"?
question_en: What do you believe when you say: 'I believe in God the Father Almighty, Maker of heaven and earth'?
answer_tet: Katak Aman eternu hosi ita-nia Na'i Jesuis Kristu, ne'ebé hosi laiha buat ida kria lalehan no rai ho buat hotu-hotu ne'ebé iha sira-nia laran, ne'ebé mós liuhosi Ninia konsellu eternu no providénsia sustenta no ukun sira, tanba Kristu Ninia Oan-Mane mak ha'u-nia Maromak no ha'u-nia Aman; iha Nia ha'u fiar ho la duvida katak Nia sei hatene providensia ha'u ho buat hotu-hotu ne'ebé nesezáriu ba isin no klamar, no liután ne'e, kualker aat ne'ebé Nia haruka mai ha'u iha moris terus ne'e Nia sei hodi fila ba ha'u-nia di'ak; tanba Nia bele halo ne'e, nu'udar Maromak Kbiit-Na'in, no prontu mós nu'udar Aman laran-metin ida.
answer_en: That the eternal Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who of nothing made heaven and earth with all that in them is, who likewise by his eternal counsel and providence upholds and governs them, is for the sake of Christ his Son my God and my Father; in whom I so trust as to have no doubt that he will provide me with all things necessary for body and soul, and further, that whatever evil he sends upon me in this troubled life he will turn to my good; for he is able to do it, being Almighty God, and willing also, being a faithful Father.

question_tet: Saida mak ó komprende liuhosi Maromak nia providénsia?
question_en: What do you understand by the providence of God?
answer_tet: Podér Kbiit-Na'in no iha fatin hotu-hotu prezente hosi Maromak, liuhosi ne'e, tanba iha Ninia lima, Nia sei sustenta lalehan no rai ho kriatura hotu-hotu, no ukun sira nune'i katak ai-fuan no du'ut, udan no bai-loron, tinan foti no tinan maran, hahan no hemu, saúde no moras, rikusoin no mehi ki'ak, tebes duni buat hotu-hotu mai la'ós liuhosi kazu, maibé liuhosi Ninia lima amizade aman nian.
answer_en: Almighty and everywhere present power of God, whereby, as it were by his hand, he still upholds heaven and earth, with all creatures, and so governs them that herbs and grass, rain and drought, fruitful and barren years, meat and drink, health and sickness, riches and poverty, yea, all things come not by chance, but by his fatherly hand.

question_tet: Saida mak nia benefísiu mai ita atu hatene katak Maromak kria, no liuhosi Ninia providénsia sei mantesa, buat hotu-hotu?
question_en: What does it profit us to know that God created, and by his providence still upholds, all things?
answer_tet: Atu ita bele si'ak iha pasir no terus, fó agradesimentu iha prosperidade, no ba futuru iha konfiansa di'ak iha ita-nia Maromak no Aman laran-metin, katak laiha kriatura ruma ne'ebé sei haketak ita hosi Ninia domin, tanba kriatura hotu-hotu iha Ninia lima ho tomak to'o se la ho Ninia hakarak sira la bele sirkula ka book an.
answer_en: That we may be patient in adversity, thankful in prosperity, and for the future have good confidence in our faithful God and Father, that no creature shall separate us from his love, since all creatures are so completely in his hand that without his will they cannot so much as move.

question_tet: Tanba saida mak Maromak nia Oan-Mane hetan bolu Jesuis, ne'e mak, Salvadór?
question_en: Why is the Son of God called Jesus, that is, Savior?
answer_tet: Tanba Nia salva ita hosi ita-nia sala sira, no tanba salvasaun la tenke hetan buka ka hetan iha seluk ruma.
answer_en: Because he saves us from our sins, and because salvation is not to be sought or found in any other.

question_tet: Ema sira ne'ebé buka sira-nia salvasaun no di'ak hosi santu sira, hosi sira-nia an rasik, ka iha fatin seluk ruma, fiar mós iha Salvadór mesak Jesuis ka?
question_en: Do those also believe in the only Savior Jesus, who seek their salvation and welfare of saints, of themselves, or anywhere else?
answer_tet: Lae; maski sira gaba an kona-ba Nia, maibé iha hahalok sira nega Salvadór mesak Jesuis. Tanba ka Jesuis la'ós Salvadór tomak ida, ka sira ne'ebé liuhosi fiar loloos simu Salvadór ne'e tenke hetan iha Nia buat hotu-hotu ne'ebé nesezáriu ba sira-nia salvasaun.
answer_en: No; although they make their boast of him, yet in works they deny the only Savior Jesus. For either Jesus is not a complete Savior, or those who by true faith receive this Savior must find in him all that is necessary to their salvation.

category_tet: Jesuis Kristu Ema ne'ebé Hetan Olementu
question_tet: Tanba saida mak Nia hetan bolu Kristu, ne'e mak, Ema ne'ebé Hetan Olementu?
question_en: Why is he called Christ, that is, Anointed?
answer_tet: Tanba Nia hetan ordenasaun hosi Maromak Aman, no hetan olementu ho Espíritu Santu, atu sai ita-nia Profeta no Mestre boot liu, ne'ebé revelar tomak tiha mai ita Maromak nia konsellu subar no hakarak kona-ba ita-nia redensaun; no atu sai ita-nia Amululik Boot mesak ida de'it, ne'ebé liuhosi sakrifísiu ida hosi Ninia isin sosa tiha ita, no halo interseasaun beibeik ba ita iha Aman nia oin; no atu sai ita-nia Liurai eternu, ne'ebé ukun ita liuhosi Ninia Liafuan no Espíritu, no defende no preserva ita iha ksolok hosi salvasaun ne'ebé Nia sosa tiha ba ita.
answer_en: Because he is ordained of God the Father, and anointed with the Holy Ghost, to be our chief Prophet and Teacher, who has fully revealed to us the secret counsel and will of God concerning our redemption; and to be our only High Priest, who by the one sacrifice of his body has redeemed us, and makes continual intercession for us with the Father; and to be our eternal King, who governs us by his Word and Spirit, and who defends and preserves us in the enjoyment of that salvation he has purchased for us.

question_tet: Maibé tanba saida mak ó hetan bolu ema kristaun ida?
question_en: But why are you called a Christian?
answer_tet: Tanba liuhosi fiar ha'u mak membru ida hosi Kristu no nune'i fahe iha Ninia olementu, atu nune'i ha'u bele konfesa Ninia naran, offera ha'u-nia an nu'udar sakrifísiu moris agradesimentu nian ba Nia, no ho konsiénsia livre no di'ak funu hasoru sala no diabu iha moris ne'e, no iha futuru ukun hamutuk ho Nia ba nafatin iha kriatura hotu-hotu nia leten.
answer_en: Because I am a member of Christ by faith and thus share in his anointing, so that I may confess his name, offer myself a living sacrifice of thankfulness to him, and with a free and good conscience fight against sin and the devil in this life, and hereafter reign with him eternally over all creatures.

question_tet: Tanba saida mak Nia hetan bolu Maromak nia "Oan-Mane mesak", bainhira ita mós mak Maromak nia oan sira?
question_en: Why is he called God's "only begotten Son," since we also are children of God?
answer_tet: Tanba Kristu mesak de'it mak Maromak nia Oan-Mane eternu no natural; maibé ita, hetan adosaun nu'udar Maromak nia oan sira liuhosi grasa tanba Ninia mehi.
answer_en: Because Christ alone is the eternal, natural Son of God; we, however, are children of God by adoption through grace for his sake.

question_tet: Tanba saida mak ó bolu Nia "ita-nia Na'i"?
question_en: Why do you call him "our Lord"?
answer_tet: Tanba Nia redime tiha ita, isin no klamar, hosi ita-nia sala hotu-hotu, la'ós ho osan-mean ka osan-mutin, maibé ho Ninia ran folin-boot, no liberta tiha ita hosi diabu nia podér hotu-hotu, no halo ita sai Ninia propriedade rasik.
answer_en: Because he has redeemed us, body and soul, from all our sins, not with gold or silver, but with his precious blood, and has delivered us from all the power of the devil, and has made us his own possession.

category_tet: Kristu nia Koñsepsaun no Moris Santu
question_tet: Saida mak significadu katak Nia "hetan koñsebe liuhosi Espíritu Santu, moris hosi virjem Maria"?
question_en: What does it mean that he "was conceived by the Holy Spirit, born of the virgin Mary"?
answer_tet: Katak Maromak nia Oan-Mane eternu, ne'ebé mak no kontinua sai Maromak loloos no eternu, foti ba Nia an natureza loloos ema nian, hosi virjem Maria nia isin no ran, liuhosi servisu hosi Espíritu Santu; atu nune'i Nia mós bele sai David nia jerasaun loloos, hanesan Ninia maun-alin sira iha buat hotu-hotu, eksatu sala.
answer_en: That God's eternal Son, who is and continues true and eternal God, took upon himself the very nature of man, of the flesh and blood of the virgin Mary, by the operation of the Holy Spirit; so that he might also be the true seed of David, like his brothers in all things, sin except.

category_tet: Kristu nia Koñsepsaun no Moris Santu
question_tet: Benefísiu saida mak ó simu hosi Kristu nia koñsepsaun no moris santu?
question_en: What benefit do you receive from the holy conception and birth of Christ?
answer_tet: Katak Nia mak ita-nia Mediadór, no ho Ninia inosénsia no santidade perfeitu takat, iha Maromak nia oin, ha'u-nia sala, ne'ebé ha'u hetan koñsebe iha laran.
answer_en: That he is our Mediator, and with his innocence and perfect holiness covers, in the sight of God, my sin, wherein I was conceived.

question_tet: Saida mak ó komprende liuhosi liafuan "terus"?
question_en: What do you understand by the word "suffered"?
answer_tet: Katak tempu tomak ne'ebé Nia moris iha rai, maibé liuliu iha ninia moris nia rohan, Nia lori, iha isin no klamar, Maromak nia hirus hasoru ema tomak nia sala; atu nune'i, liuhosi Ninia terus nu'udar sakrifísiu atona mesak ida de'it, Nia bele redime ita-nia isin no klamar hosi kondenasaun eternu, no hetan mai ita Maromak nia grasa, justisa, no moris rohan-la'ek.
answer_en: That all the time he lived on earth, but especially at the end of his life, he bore, in body and soul, the wrath of God against the sin of the whole human race; that, by his suffering as the only atoning sacrifice, he might redeem our body and soul from everlasting damnation, and obtain for us God's grace, righteousness, and eternal life.

question_tet: Tanba saida mak Nia terus "iha Pónsio Pilatos nia okos" nu'udar juís?
question_en: Why did he suffer "under Pontius Pilate" as judge?
answer_tet: Atu nune'i Nia, nu'udar ema inosente, hetan kondena hosi juís temporál, no liuhosi ne'e liberta ita hosi Maromak nia juízu todan ne'ebé atu monu ba ita nia leten.
answer_en: That he, being innocent, might be condemned by the temporal judge, and thereby deliver us from the severe judgment of God which was to fall upon us.

question_tet: Iha buat seluk tan iha Ninia "hetan kruzifika" duké Nia terus mate seluk ruma ka?
question_en: Is there anything more in his being "crucified" than if he had suffered some other death?
answer_tet: Loos, tanba liuhosi ne'e ha'u hetan garantia katak Nia foti ba Nia an malisan ne'ebé tur ba ha'u nia leten, tanba mate kruzifikasaun nian hetan malisan hosi Maromak.
answer_en: Yes, for by this I am assured that he took upon himself the curse which lay upon me, because the death of the cross was accursed of God.

question_tet: Tanba saida mak nesezáriu ba Kristu atu haraik an to'o "mate"?
question_en: Why was it necessary for Christ to humble himself even "unto death"?
answer_tet: Tanba tuir Maromak nia justisa no lia-loos, satisfasaun ba ita-nia sala sira la bele hetan halo ho dalan seluk duké liuhosi Maromak nia Oan-Mane nia mate.
answer_en: Because with respect to the justice and truth of God, satisfaction for our sins could be made no otherwise than by the death of the Son of God.

question_tet: Tanba saida mak Nia hetan hakoi, nune'i prova katak Nia mate loloos?
question_en: Why was he buried, thereby proving that he was really dead?
answer_tet: Atu nune'i hatudu katak Nia mate loloos.
answer_en: Thereby proving that he was really dead.

question_tet: Tanba Kristu mate tiha ba ita, tanba saida mak ita mós tenke mate?
question_en: Since Christ died for us, why must we also die?
answer_tet: Ita-nia mate la'ós atu selu ba ita-nia sala sira, maibé de'it atu putu no haraik an hosi ita-nia sala sira no nia sai liur-fatin ida ba moris rohan-la'ek.
answer_en: Our death is not a payment for our sins, but it only puts an end to sin and is a passing into eternal life.

question_tet: Benefísiu liután saida mak ita simu hosi Kristu nia sakrifísiu no mate iha krús nia leten?
question_en: What further benefit do we receive from the sacrifice and death of Christ on the cross?
answer_tet: Katak liuhosi Ninia podér ita-nia ema tuan hetan kruzifika, oho, no hakoi hamutuk ho Nia, atu nune'i ita-nia isin-sala nia hakarak aat sira la ukun liután iha ita-nia laran, maibé ita bele offera ita-nia an nu'udar sakrifísiu agradesimentu nian ba Nia.
answer_en: That by his power our old man is crucified, slain, and buried with him, that the evil desires of the flesh may no longer reign in us, but that we may offer ourselves to him as a sacrifice of thanksgiving.

question_tet: Tanba saida mak aumenta liafuan sira-ne'e: "Nia tun ba infernu"?
question_en: Why is there added: "He descended into hell"?
answer_tet: Atu nune'i iha ha'u-nia tentasaun todan liu hotu sira ha'u bele hetan mehi no kunsola tomak katak ha'u-nia Na'i Jesuis Kristu, liuhosi Ninia angústia, terus, no ta'uk ne'ebé mehi liu hotu iha Ninia klamar iha krús nia leten no ulu-fatin kedu sira, liberta tiha ha'u hosi angústia no terus infernu nian.
answer_en: That in my severest temptations I may be assured in heart and comforted that my Lord Jesus Christ, by his inexpressible anguish, pains, and terrors, which he suffered in his soul on the cross and before, has delivered me from the anguish and torment of hell.

question_tet: Oinsá mak Kristu nia rezurreisaun benefisia ita?
question_en: How does Christ's resurrection benefit us?
answer_tet: Dahuluk, liuhosi Ninia rezurreisaun Nia manán tiha mate, atu nune'i Nia bele halo ita fahe iha justisa ne'ebé Nia sosa tiha mai ita liuhosi Ninia mate. Daruak, liuhosi Ninia podér ita mós hetan foti hi'as na'in ba moris foun ida. Datolu, Kristu nia rezurreisaun mak penhor ida ne'ebé garantidu ba ita kona-ba ita-nia rezurreisaun gloriozu iha futuru.
answer_en: First, by his resurrection he has overcome death, so that he might make us share in the righteousness which he has obtained for us by his death. Second, by his power we also are now raised up to a new life. Third, the resurrection of Christ is to us a guarantee of our glorious resurrection.

question_tet: Saida mak ó komprende liuhosi liafuan sira-ne'e "Nia sa'e ba lalehan"?
question_en: What do you mean by the words "He ascended into heaven"?
answer_tet: Katak Kristu, iha Ninia diskípulu sira-nia oin, hetan foti hi'as hosi rai sa'e ba lalehan, no iha ne'ebá Nia fahe no hela ba ita-nia di'ak to'o Nia mai fali atu tesi-lia ba ema moris no ema mate sira.
answer_en: That Christ, in the sight of his disciples, was taken up from the earth into heaven, and that he is there for our benefit until he comes again to judge the living and the dead.

question_tet: Kristu la iha hamutuk ho ita to'o mundu nia rohan, hanesan Nia prometu tiha mai ita ka?
question_en: Is not Christ then with us even to the end of the world, as he has promised us?
answer_tet: Kristu mak ema loloos no Maromak loloos. Tuir Ninia mehi humanidade nian Nia la iha liután iha rai; maibé tuir Ninia divindade, majestade, grasa, no Espíritu, Nia la dook husi ita mehi ida de'it.
answer_en: Christ is true man and true God. With respect to his human nature he is no longer on earth, but with respect to his divinity, majesty, grace, and Spirit he is never absent from us.

question_tet: Maibé natureza rua iha Kristu la haketak hosi sira-nia an ho dalan ne'e ka se humanidade la iha fatin hotu-hotu ne'ebé divindade iha?
question_en: But are not the two natures in Christ separated from each other in this way if the humanity is not wherever the divinity is?
answer_tet: Lae mehi ida. Tanba divindade la bele hetan limitasaun no iha fatin hotu-hotu prezente, nune'i tuir mai katak Ninia divindade iha nakloke iha mehi li'ur hosi Ninia humanidade ne'ebé foti tiha, maibé iha tempu hanesan mós iha iha ne'e no foti nafatin unidu ho ne'e.
answer_en: Not at all. For since the divinity is incomprehensible and everywhere present, it must follow that the divinity is indeed beyond the bounds of the humanity which it has taken on, and yet is nonetheless in it and remains personally united to it.

category_tet: Kristu nia Sa'e ba Lalehan nia Benefísiu
question_tet: Oinsá mak Kristu nia sa'e ba lalehan benefisia ita?
question_en: How does Christ's ascension into heaven benefit us?
answer_tet: Dahuluk, Nia mak ita-nia Advogadu iha lalehan iha Ninia Aman nia oin. Daruak, ita iha ita-nia isin-ran iha lalehan nu'udar penhor certu ida katak Nia, nu'udar ulun, sei mós lori ita, Ninia membru sira, sa'e ba Nia an rasik. Datolu, Nia haruka mai ita Ninia Espíritu Santu nu'udar penhor troka nian, liuhosi ne'e Ninia podér ita buka buat sira-ne'ebé iha leten, ne'ebé Kristu tur iha Maromak nia liman-kuana, la'ós buat sira-ne'ebé iha rai.
answer_en: First, he is our Advocate in heaven in the presence of his Father. Second, we have our flesh in heaven as a sure guarantee that he, as the head, will also take us, his members, up to himself. Third, he sends us his Spirit as a counter-guarantee, by whose power we seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated at the right hand of God, not the things that are on earth.

category_tet: Kristu Tur iha Maromak nia Liman-Kuana
question_tet: Tanba saida mak aumenta liafuan sira-ne'e: "No tur iha Maromak nia liman-kuana"?
question_en: Why is it added: "And sits at the right hand of God"?
answer_tet: Tanba Kristu sa'e ba lalehan ba fin ida-ne'e, atu Nia hatudu sai iha ne'ebá nu'udar Ulun hosi Ninia kireja, liuhosi ne'ebé Aman ukun buat hotu-hotu.
answer_en: Because Christ ascended into heaven for the purpose of showing himself there as Head of his church, through whom the Father governs all things.

question_tet: Oinsá mak Kristu, ita-nia Ulun, nia glória benefisia ita?
question_en: How does the glory of Christ, our Head, benefit us?
answer_tet: Dahuluk, liuhosi Ninia Espíritu Santu Nia fakar kunsede dom lalehan nian sira ba ita, Ninia membru sira. Daruak, liuhosi Ninia podér Nia defende no preserva ita hasoru inimigu hotu-hotu.
answer_en: First, by his Holy Spirit he pours out heavenly gifts upon us, his members. Second, by his power he defends and preserves us against all enemies.

question_tet: Kunsola saida mak mai ó katak Kristu sei mai atu tesi-lia ba ema moris no ema mate sira?
question_en: What comfort is it to you that Christ shall come to judge the living and the dead?
answer_tet: Katak iha terus no persekisaun hotu-hotu ha'u foti ha'u-nia ulun ho ta'uk-laek Hein Juís ne'e de'it hosi lalehan ne'ebé submete tiha Ninia an uluk ba Maromak nia juízu ha'u-nia fatin no hasai tiha malisan hotu-hotu hosi ha'u; Nia sei soe Ninia no ha'u-nia inimigu hotu-hotu ba iha kondenasaun eternu, maibé lori ha'u ho ema hili-sira hotu-hotu ba iha Ninia an rasik ba iha ksolok no glória lalehan nian.
answer_en: That in all my sorrows and persecutions, with uplifted head I look for the very same Judge from heaven who has before submitted himself to the judgment of God for my sake and has taken away all curse from me; he will cast all his and my enemies into everlasting condemnation, but he will take me with all his elect to himself into heavenly joy and glory.

question_tet: Saida mak ó fiar kona-ba Espíritu Santu?
question_en: What do you believe concerning the Holy Spirit?
answer_tet: Dahuluk, katak Nia mak Maromak eternu koadjutór ho Aman no Oan-Mane. Daruak, katak Nia mós hetan fó mai ha'u, halo ha'u liuhosi fiar loloos partisipa iha Kristu no Ninia benefísiu hotu-hotu, kunsola ha'u, no hela hamutuk ho ha'u ba nafatin.
answer_en: First, that he is co-eternal God with the Father and the Son. Second, that he is also given to me, to make me by true faith share in Christ and all his benefits, to comfort me, and to remain with me forever.

question_tet: Saida mak ó fiar kona-ba kireja katóliku santu?
question_en: What do you believe concerning the holy catholic church?
answer_tet: Ha'u fiar katak Maromak nia Oan-Mane hosi mundu nia hahuu to'o nia rohan, amuntansa no preserva mai Nia an rasik, liuhosi Ninia Espíritu no Liafuan, iha mehi fiar loloos nian, kireja ida ne'ebé hili tiha ba moris rohan-la'ek hosi humanidade tomak; no katak ha'u mak no sei nafatin sai membru moris ida hosi kireja ne'e.
answer_en: I believe that the Son of God, out of the whole human race, from the beginning of the world to its end, gathers, defends, and preserves for himself, by his Spirit and Word, in the unity of the true faith, a church chosen to everlasting life; and that I am, and forever shall remain, a living member of it.

question_tet: Saida mak ó komprende liuhosi "komuñaun santu sira-nian"?
question_en: What do you understand by "the communion of saints"?
answer_tet: Dahuluk, katak ema fiar-sira hotu-hotu no kualker ida, nu'udar membru sira, iha komuñaun hamutuk ho Kristu no iha Ninia risu no dom sira hotu-hotu. Daruak, katak kualker ida tenke sente fuan ativu atu uzu Ninia dom sira ho ksolok no voluntáriu ba profeitu no salvasaun hosi membru seluk sira.
answer_en: First, that believers one and all, as members, have communion with Christ and in all his riches and gifts. Second, that everyone should feel obliged to use his gifts readily and cheerfully for the benefit and welfare of other members.

question_tet: Saida mak ó fiar kona-ba "perdua sala nian"?
question_en: What do you believe concerning "the forgiveness of sins"?
answer_tet: Ha'u fiar katak Maromak, tanba Kristu nia satisfasaun, sei la hanoin hi'as ha'u-nia sala sira, nem ha'u-nia mehi korruptu ne'ebé ha'u tenke funu hasoru iha moris tomak ne'e; maibé ho grasa haraik mai ha'u Kristu nia justisa, atu nune'i ha'u keta monu ba juízu eternu Maromak nian.
answer_en: I believe that God, because of Christ's satisfaction, will no more remember my sins, nor my corrupt nature with which I have to struggle all my life long; but will graciously grant me the righteousness of Christ, that I may never come into condemnation.

question_tet: Kunsola saida mak "rezurreisaun isin nian" offera ba ó?
question_en: What comfort does "the resurrection of the body" offer you?
answer_tet: Katak la'ós de'it ha'u-nia klamar depoiz hosi moris ne'e sei hetan foti kedas sa'e ba Kristu ne'ebé mak nia Ulun, maibé mós isin ne'e rasik hosi ha'u, foti hi'as liuhosi Kristu nia podér, sei hetan unifika fali ho ha'u-nia klamar no halo hanesan ho Kristu nia isin gloriozu.
answer_en: That not only shall my soul after this life immediately be taken up to Christ its Head, but also this my body, raised by the power of Christ, shall be reunited with my soul and made like Christ's glorious body.

question_tet: Kunsola saida mak ó simu hosi artigu kona-ba "moris rohan-la'ek"?
question_en: What comfort do you receive from the article about "the life everlasting"?
answer_tet: Katak, hanesan ha'u sente agora iha ha'u-nia fuan hahuu hosi ksolok eternu, nune'i depoiz hosi moris ne'e ha'u sei simu ksolok perfeitu ne'ebé matan la haree, tilun la rona, nem tama iha ema nia fuan, atu hahi'i Maromak ba nafatin iha ne'ebá.
answer_en: That, since I now feel in my heart the beginning of eternal joy, I shall after this life possess perfect blessedness, such as eye has not seen, nor ear heard, nor has entered into the heart of man, therein to praise God forever.

question_tet: Maibé saida mak nia ajuda ó agora katak ó fiar buat ne'e hotu?
question_en: But what does it help you now that you believe all this?
answer_tet: Katak ha'u sai justu iha Kristu iha Maromak nia oin, no herdeiru ba moris rohan-la'ek.
answer_en: That I am righteous in Christ before God and an heir to life everlasting.

question_tet: Oinsá mak ó sai justu iha Maromak nia oin?
question_en: How are you righteous before God?
answer_tet: De'it liuhosi fiar loloos iha Jesuis Kristu. Maski ha'u-nia konsiénsia akuza ha'u katak ha'u halo sala aat tebes hasoru Maromak nia ukun-fuan hotu-hotu no la hali'is ida kualker hosi sira, no katak ha'u korruptu nafatin to'o agora ba aat hotu-hotu; maibé Maromak, la ho ha'u-nia mehi merese ida de'it, de'it hosi grasa pureza nian, fakar no atribui mai ha'u Kristu nia satisfasaun perfeitu, justisa, no santidade, hanesan ha'u laiha tiha sala ida no la halo tiha sala ruma, tebes duni hanesan ha'u rasik kumpri tiha obediénsia hotu-hotu ne'ebé Kristu kumpri tiha mai ha'u; se de'it ha'u simu benefísiu ne'e ho fuan fiar nian.
answer_en: Only by true faith in Jesus Christ. Although my conscience accuses me that I have grievously sinned against all God's commandments, have never kept any of them, and am still prone to all evil, yet God, without any merit of my own, out of pure grace, imputes to me the perfect satisfaction, righteousness, and holiness of Christ. He grants these to me as if I had never had nor committed any sin, and as if I myself had accomplished all the obedience which Christ has rendered for me, if only I accept this gift with a believing heart.

question_tet: Tanba saida mak ó dehan katak ó sai justu liuhosi fiar de'it?
question_en: Why do you say that you are righteous by faith only?
answer_tet: La'ós tanba ha'u haksolok ba Maromak tanba valór hosi ha'u-nia fiar; maibé tanba Kristu nia satisfasaun, justisa, no santidade de'it mak ha'u-nia justisa iha Maromak nia oin, no ha'u la bele simu no foti nia ba ha'u an rasik ho dalan seluk duké liuhosi fiar de'it.
answer_en: Not that I am acceptable to God on account of the worthiness of my faith; but because only the satisfaction, righteousness, and holiness of Christ is my righteousness before God, and I can receive the same and make it my own in no other way than by faith only.

question_tet: Maibé tanba saida mak ita-nia hahalok di'ak sira la bele sai tomak ka parte hosi ita-nia justisa iha Maromak nia oin?
question_en: But why cannot our good works be the whole or part of our righteousness before God?
answer_tet: Tanba justisa ne'ebé bele sai tiha iha Maromak nia oin juízu nian tenke perfeitu tebes no nurensa ho tomak ba Maromak nia lei; maibé ita-nia hahalok di'ak sira hotu-hotu iha moris ne'e naksobu no iha sala laran.
answer_en: Because the righteousness which can stand before the judgment seat of God must be perfect throughout and entirely conformable to the divine law; whereas even our best works in this life are all imperfect and defiled with sin.

question_tet: Oinsá mak ita-nia hahalok di'ak sira la merese buat ida, bainhira Maromak nia hakarak mak atu fó galardaun ba sira iha moris ne'e no iha moris ne'ebé atu mai?
question_en: How is it that our good works merit nothing, while yet it is God's will to reward them in this life and in the life to come?
answer_tet: Galardaun ne'e hetan fó la'ós tanba mehi merese nian, maibé hosi grasa.
answer_en: The reward comes not of merit, but of grace.

question_tet: Maibé doutrina ne'e la halo ema baruk no profanu ka lae?
question_en: But does not this doctrine make men careless and profane?
answer_tet: Lae, tanba la bele halo katak ema sira-ne'e ne'ebé hetan foti tama ba Kristu liuhosi fiar loloos la kunsede ai-fuan agradesimentu nian.
answer_en: No, for it is impossible that those who are implanted into Christ by true faith should not bring forth fruits of thankfulness.

question_tet: Tanba ita sai partisipante hosi Kristu no Ninia benefísiu hotu-hotu liuhosi fiar de'it, hosi ne'ebé mak fiar ne'e mai?
question_en: Since then we are made partakers of Christ and all his benefits by faith only, where does this faith come from?
answer_tet: Espíritu Santu mehi servisu nia iha ita-nia fuan sira liuhosi pregasaun evanjellu santu nian, no konfirma nia liuhosi uzu sakramentu sira nian.
answer_en: The Holy Spirit works it in our hearts by the preaching of the holy gospel, and confirms it by the use of the holy sacraments.

question_tet: Saida mak sakramentu sira?
question_en: What are the sacraments?
answer_tet: Sakramentu sira mak sinal santu no selu ne'ebé haree ho matan hatato'o tiha hosi Maromak, atu nune'i, liuhosi uzu hosi sira-ne'e, Nia bele declarar no selu di'ak liu mai ita evanjellu nia promesa; ne'e mak katak Nia kunsede gratuitamentu mai ita perdua sala nian no moris rohan-la'ek, tanba Kristu nia sakrifísiu atona mesak ida de'it ne'ebé kumpri tiha iha krús nia leten.
answer_en: The sacraments are holy visible signs and seals appointed of God for this end, that by the use thereof he may the more fully declare and seal to us the promise of the gospel: namely, that of free grace he grants us the forgiveness of sins and everlasting life for the sake of the one sacrifice of Christ accomplished on the cross.

question_tet: Maromak nia Liafuan no sakramentu sira se nune'i hetan intendu atu dirije ita-nia fiar ba Jesuis Kristu nia sakrifísiu iha krús nia leten nu'udar hahuu mesak ida hosi ita-nia salvasaun ka?
question_en: Are both the Word and the sacraments then intended to direct our faith to the sacrifice of Jesus Christ on the cross as the only ground of our salvation?
answer_tet: Loos tebes, tanba Espíritu Santu hanorin ita iha evanjellu no selu liuhosi sakramentu sira katak ita-nia salvasaun tomak resta iha Kristu nia sakrifísiu mesak ida de'it ne'ebé offera tiha ba ita iha krús nia leten.
answer_en: Right indeed, for the Holy Spirit teaches in the gospel and assures us by the sacraments that our whole salvation rests on the one sacrifice of Christ made for us on the cross.

question_tet: Sakramentu hira mak Kristu hatato'o tiha iha Testamentu Foun?
question_en: How many sacraments has Christ instituted in the New Testament?
answer_tet: Rua: Batizmu Santu no Na'i nia Hahan Santu.
answer_en: Two: Holy Baptism and the Holy Supper.

question_tet: Oinsá mak hetan mehi significadu no selu ba ó iha Batizmu Santu katak ó iha parte iha Kristu nia sakrifísiu mesak ida de'it iha krús nia leten?
question_en: How is it signified and sealed to you in Holy Baptism that you have part in the one sacrifice of Christ on the cross?
answer_tet: Nune'i: katak Kristu hatato'o tiha fihir bee li'ur nian ne'e no fakar hamutuk ne'e promesa katak ha'u hetan fihir ho Ninia ran no Espíritu hosi ha'u-nia klamar nia sujedade sira, ne'e mak hosi ha'u-nia sala sira hotu-hotu, tamansan hanesan ha'u hetan fihir li'ur ho bee, ne'ebé uza baibain atu hasai isin nia sujedade.
answer_en: Thus: that Christ has appointed this outward washing with water and added the promise that I am washed with his blood and Spirit from the pollution of my soul, that is, from all my sins, as certainly as I am washed outwardly with water, which is used to take away the filth of the body.

question_tet: Saida mak significadu atu hetan fihir ho Kristu nia ran no Espíritu?
question_en: What is it to be washed with the blood and Spirit of Christ?
answer_tet: Katak simu hosi Maromak perdua sala nian liuhosi grasa, tanba Kristu nia ran, ne'ebé Nia fakar mai ita iha Ninia sakrifísiu iha krús nia leten; no mós atu hetan renova liuhosi Espíritu Santu no hetan santifika atu sai membru ida hosi Kristu, atu nune'i ita bele mate tan no tan ba sala no hatudu moris santu ida ho la kulpá.
answer_en: It is to receive from God the forgiveness of sins, freely by grace, for the sake of Christ's blood, which he shed for us in his sacrifice on the cross; and also to be renewed by the Holy Spirit and sanctified to be a member of Christ, that so we may more and more die unto sin and lead a holy and blameless life.

question_tet: Iha ne'ebé mak Kristu prometu tiha katak Nia sei fihir ita ho Ninia ran no Espíritu tamansan hanesan ita hetan fihir ho bee batizmu nian?
question_en: Where has Christ promised that he will as certainly wash us with his blood and Spirit as we are washed with the water of baptism?
answer_tet: Iha batizmu nia hatato'o nian, ne'ebé la'o nune'i: 'Ne'e duni ba halo diskípulu ba nasaun hotu-hotu, batiza sira iha Aman, no Oan-Mane, no Espíritu Santu nia naran.' 'Sé de'it mak fiar no hetan batiza sei hetan salvasaun, maibé sé de'it mak la fiar sei hetan kondena.' Promesa ne'e mós hetan repetir iha ne'ebé Escritura bolu batizmu fihir moris foun nian no fihir sai hosi sala sira.
answer_en: In the institution of baptism, which runs thus: 'Go therefore and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit.' 'Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved, but whoever does not believe will be condemned.' This promise is also repeated where Scripture calls baptism the washing of regeneration and the washing away of sins.

question_tet: Se nune'i fihir li'ur ho bee ne'e rasik mak fihir sai hosi sala sira ka?
question_en: Is then the outward washing with water itself the washing away of sins?
answer_tet: Lae, tanba Jesuis Kristu nia ran no Espíritu Santu mesak de'it mak hamoos ita hosi sala hotu-hotu.
answer_en: No, for only the blood of Jesus Christ and the Holy Spirit cleanse us from all sins.

question_tet: Tanba saida mak se nune'i Espíritu Santu bolu batizmu fihir moris foun nian no fihir sai hosi sala sira?
question_en: Why then does the Holy Spirit call baptism the washing of regeneration and the washing away of sins?
answer_tet: Maromak ko'alia nune'i la'ós la ho razaun boot: ne'e mak, la'ós de'it atu hanorin ita liuhosi ne'e katak hanesan isin nia sujedade hetan foti sai liuhosi bee, nune'i ita-nia sala sira hetan foti sai liuhosi Kristu nia ran no Espíritu; maibé liuliu tan liuhosi penhor no sinal divinu ne'e atu haraik garantia mai ita katak ita hetan fihir loloos hosi ita-nia sala sira iha espíritu laran hanesan ita-nia isin sira hetan fihir ho bee.
answer_en: God speaks thus not without great cause: namely, not only to teach us thereby that as the filth of the body is taken away by water, so our sins are taken away by the blood and Spirit of Christ; but much more by this divine pledge and token to assure us that we are as really washed from our sins spiritually as our bodies are washed with water.

question_tet: Kosok-oan sira mós tenke hetan batiza ka?
question_en: Are infants also to be baptized?
answer_tet: Loos, tanba bainhira sira, hanesan mós ema boot, hetan naklahat iha Maromak nia aliansa no kireja laran; no bainhira redensaun hosi sala liuhosi Kristu nia ran no Espíritu Santu, autori fiar nian, hetan prometu ba sira la oituan duké ba ema boot; sira tenke mós liuhosi batizmu, nu'udar sinal aliansa nian, hetan foti tama ba kireja kristaun, no hetan fahe hosi ema la fiar sira-nia oan sira, hanesan halo tiha iha Testamentu Tuan liuhosi sirkunsizasaun, ne'ebé nia fatin batizmu hetan hatato'o iha Testamentu Foun.
answer_en: Yes, for since they, as well as the adult, are included in the covenant and church of God; and since both redemption from sin by the blood of Christ and the Holy Spirit, the author of faith, is promised to them no less than to the adult; they must also by baptism, as a sign of the covenant, be ingrafted into the Christian church, and distinguished from the children of unbelievers, as was done in the Old Testament by circumcision, in place of which baptism is appointed in the New Testament.

question_tet: Oinsá mak ó hetan avizu no garantia iha Na'i nia Hahan katak ó mak partisipante ida hosi Kristu nia sakrifísiu mesak ida de'it ne'e, kumpri tiha iha krús nia leten, no hosi Ninia benefísiu hotu-hotu?
question_en: How are you admonished and assured in the Lord's Supper that you are a partaker of that one sacrifice of Christ, accomplished on the cross, and of all his benefits?
answer_tet: Nune'i: Katak Kristu haruka tiha ha'u no ema fiar-sira hotu-hotu atu han hosi paun sigidu ne'e no hemu hosi kupa ne'e, iha mehi hanoin tiha Nia; no juntu tiha ho ne'e promesa sira-ne'e: Dahuluk, katak Ninia isin hetan offera no sigi iha krús nia leten mai ha'u, no Ninia ran hetan fakar mai ha'u, tamansan hanesan ha'u haree ho ha'u-nia matan Na'i nia paun sigidu mai ha'u no kupa hetan kunsede mai ha'u; no liután ne'e, katak Nia rasik han no nuri ha'u-nia klamar ba moris rohan-la'ek, ho Ninia isin kruzifikadu no ran ne'ebé fakar, tamansan hanesan ha'u simu hosi ministru nia lima, no taste ho ha'u-nia bikan Na'i nia paun no kupa, nu'udar sinal certu hosi Kristu nia isin no ran.
answer_en: Thus: That Christ has commanded me and all believers to eat of this broken bread and to drink of this cup, in remembrance of him; and has joined therewith these promises: First, that his body was offered and broken on the cross for me, and his blood shed for me, as certainly as I see with my eyes the bread of the Lord broken for me and the cup communicated to me; and further, that he himself feeds and nourishes my soul to everlasting life, with his crucified body and shed blood, as assuredly as I receive from the hand of the minister, and taste with my mouth the bread and cup of the Lord, as certain signs of the body and blood of Christ.

question_tet: Saida mak se nune'i han isin kruzifikadu no hemu ran fakar hosi Kristu?
question_en: What is it then to eat the crucified body and drink the shed blood of Christ?
answer_tet: La'ós de'it atu simu ho fuan fiar nian Kristu nia terus no mate hotu-hotu no liuhosi ne'e hetan perdua sala nian no moris rohan-la'ek; maibé mós, sirkunsia hosi ne'e, sai unidu tan no tan ba Ninia isin santu liuhosi Espíritu Santu, ne'ebé hela iha Kristu no iha ita; atu nune'i ita, maski Kristu iha lalehan no ita iha rai, ita nu'udar isin hosi Ninia isin no ruin hosi Ninia ruin sira; no katak ita moris, no hetan ukun ba nafatin, liuhosi Espíritu ida, hanesan membru sira hosi isin ida de'it liuhosi klamar ida.
answer_en: It is not only to embrace with a believing heart all the sufferings and death of Christ and thereby to obtain the forgiveness of sins and life everlasting; but also, besides that, to become more and more united to his sacred body by the Holy Spirit, who dwells both in Christ and in us; so that we, though Christ is in heaven and we on earth, are notwithstanding flesh of his flesh and bone of his bones; and that we live, and are governed forever, by one Spirit, as the members of the same body are by one soul.

question_tet: Iha ne'ebé mak Kristu prometu tiha katak Nia sei tamansan han no nuri ema fiar-sira ho Ninia isin no ran, hanesan sira han hosi paun sigidu ne'e no hemu hosi kupa ne'e?
question_en: Where has Christ promised that he will as certainly feed and nourish believers with his body and blood, as they eat of this broken bread and drink of this cup?
answer_tet: Iha hahan nia hatato'o nian, ne'ebé la'o nune'i: 'Na'i Jesuis iha kalalan ne'ebé Nia hetan traidór, foti paun, no bainhira Nia fó tiha agradesimentu, Nia sigi nia, no dehan, "Ne'e mak Ha'u-nia isin ne'ebé ba imi. Halo ne'e iha mehi hanoin Ha'u." Ho dalan hanesan mós kupa, depoiz hahan, dehan, "Kupa ne'e mak aliansa foun iha Ha'u-nia ran. Halo ne'e, beibeik bainhira imi hemu nia, iha mehi hanoin Ha'u." Tanba beibeik bainhira imi han paun ne'e no hemu kupa ne'e, imi hatudu sai Na'i nia mate to'o Nia mai.' No promesa ne'e mós hetan repetir hosi São Paulo, iha ne'ebé nia dehan: 'Kupa bensan nian ne'ebé ita abensaun, la'ós partisipasaun ida iha Kristu nia ran ka? Paun ne'ebé ita sigi, la'ós partisipasaun ida iha Kristu nia isin ka? Tanba iha paun ida, ita ne'ebé barak mak isin ida de'it, tanba ita hotu partisipa iha paun ida ne'e.'
answer_en: In the institution of the supper, which runs thus: 'The Lord Jesus on the night when he was betrayed took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke it, and said, "This is my body which is for you. Do this in remembrance of me." In the same way also the cup, after supper, saying, "This cup is the new covenant in my blood. Do this, as often as you drink it, in remembrance of me." For as often as you eat this bread and drink the cup, you proclaim the Lord's death until he comes.' And this promise is also repeated by St. Paul, where he says: 'The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not a participation in the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not a participation in the body of Christ? Because there is one bread, we who are many are one body, for we all partake of the one bread.'

question_tet: Se nune'i paun no tua-uvas sai Kristu nia isin no ran loloos ka?
question_en: Do then the bread and wine become the very body and blood of Christ?
answer_tet: Lae, maibé hanesan bee iha batizmu la hetan troka ba Kristu nia ran, nem sai fihir sai hosi sala sira nia an rasik, nu'udar de'it penhor no garantia divinu hosi ne'e; nune'i mós paun santu iha Na'i nia Hahan la sai Kristu nia isin loloos, maski tuir natureza no kualidade sira hosi sakramentu sira nia hetan bolu Jesuis Kristu nia isin.
answer_en: No, but as the water in baptism is not changed into the blood of Christ, nor becomes the washing away of sins itself, being only the divine token and assurance thereof; so also the holy bread in the Lord's Supper does not become the very body of Christ, though agreeably to the nature and properties of sacraments it is called the body of Christ Jesus.

question_tet: Tanba saida mak se nune'i Kristu bolu paun Ninia isin, no kupa Ninia ran, ka aliansa foun iha Ninia ran; no Paulo "komuñaun hosi Kristu nia isin no ran"?
question_en: Why then doth Christ call the bread his body, and the cup his blood, or the new covenant in his blood; and Paul the "communion of the body and blood of Christ"?
answer_tet: Kristu ko'alia nune'i la'ós la ho razaun boot: ne'e mak, la'ós de'it liuhosi ne'e atu hanorin ita, katak hanesan paun no tua-uvas sustenta moris temporál ne'e, nune'i Ninia isin kruzifikadu no ran ne'ebé fakar mak han no hemu loloos liuhosi ne'ebé ita-nia klamar hetan nuri ba moris rohan-la'ek; maibé liuliu tan liuhosi sinal no penhor haree matan sira-ne'e atu haraik garantia mai ita, katak ita mak partisipante loloos hosi Ninia isin no ran loloos (liuhosi servisu hosi Espíritu Santu) hanesan ita simu liuhosi ibun isin nian sinal santu sira-ne'e iha mehi hanoin tiha Nia; no katak Ninia terus no obediénsia hotu-hotu tamansan ita-nian, hanesan ita iha ita-nia pessoa rasik terus no halo satisfasaun ba ita-nia sala sira ba Maromak.
answer_en: Christ speaks thus not without great cause: namely, not only thereby to teach us, that as bread and wine support this temporal life, so his crucified body and shed blood are the true meat and drink whereby our souls are fed to eternal life; but more especially by these visible signs and pledges to assure us, that we are as really partakers of his true body and blood (by the operation of the Holy Spirit) as we receive by the mouth of the body these holy tokens in remembrance of him; and that all his sufferings and obedience are as certainly ours, as if we had in our own persons suffered and made satisfaction for our sins to God.

category_tet: Na'i nia Hahan vs Misa Papál
question_tet: Diferensa saida mak iha entre Na'i nia Hahan no Misa Papál?
question_en: What difference is there between the Lord's Supper and the Popish Mass?
answer_tet: Na'i nia Hahan testifika mai ita, katak ita iha perdua tomak hosi sala hotu-hotu liuhosi Jesuis Kristu nia sakrifísiu mesak ida de'it, ne'ebé Nia rasik dala ida kumpri tiha iha krús nia leten; no katak ita liuhosi Espíritu Santu hetan foti tama ba Kristu, ne'ebé ho Ninia isin loloos agora iha lalehan iha Aman nia liman-kuana, no iha ne'ebá tenke hetan adora hosi ita. Maibé Misa hanorin katak ema moris no ema mate sira la iha perdua sala nian liuhosi Kristu nia terus sira, se la'ós Kristu mós loron-loron hetan offera ba sira liuhosi amululik sira; no liután ne'e, katak Kristu iha isin okos hosi forma paun no tua-uvas nian, no tan ne'e tenke hetan adora iha sira-ne'e; nune'i Misa iha bi'it-okos la'ós buat seluk duké nega tiha Kristu nia sakrifísiu no terus mesak ida de'it, no idolatriu malisan ida.
answer_en: The Lord's Supper testifies to us, that we have a full pardon of all sin by the only sacrifice of Jesus Christ, which he himself has once accomplished on the cross; and, that we by the Holy Spirit are ingrafted into Christ, who, with his true body is now in heaven at the right hand of the Father, and is there to be worshipped of us. But the Mass teaches, that the living and the dead have not the pardon of sins through the sufferings of Christ, unless Christ is also daily offered for them by the priests; and further, that Christ is bodily under the form of bread and wine, and is therefore to be worshipped in them; so that the Mass at bottom is nothing else than a denial of the one sacrifice and suffering of Jesus Christ, and an accursed idolatry.

question_tet: Sé sira mak tenke mai iha Na'i nia meza?
question_en: Who are to come to the table of the Lord?
answer_tet: Sira-ne'ebé la haksolok ho sira-nia an rasik tanba sira-nia sala sira, maibé fiar katak sala sira-ne mehi hetan perdua ba sira no katak sira-nia frakeza ne'ebé hela hetan takat liuhosi Kristu nia terus no mate; sira ne'ebé mós hakarak tan no tan atu hametin sira-nia fiar no atu moris di'ak liu. Maibé ema ipókrita sira no sira-ne'ebé la arrepender han no hemu juízu ba sira-nia an rasik.
answer_en: Those who are displeased with themselves because of their sins, but trust that these are forgiven them and that their remaining weakness is covered by the suffering and death of Christ; who also desire more and more to strengthen their faith and to lead a better life. But hypocrites and those who do not repent eat and drink judgment to themselves.

question_tet: Ema sira-ne'ebé liuhosi sira-nia konfesa no moris hatudu katak sira la fiar no aat mós tenke hetan simu ba Hahan ne'e ka?
question_en: Are those also to be admitted to this Supper who by their confession and life show that they are unbelieving and ungodly?
answer_tet: Lae, tanba se nune'i Maromak nia aliansa hetan profana no Ninia hirus sai lakan hasoru kongregasaun tomak. Tan ne'e, tuir Kristu no Ninia apostolu sira-nia ukun-fuan, kireja kristaun iha dever atu hasai ema sira kualidade ne'e liuhosi xave sira hosi lalehan nia reinu to'o sira hatudu mehi moris nian foun.
answer_en: No, for then the covenant of God would be profaned and his wrath kindled against the whole congregation. Therefore, according to the command of Christ and his apostles, the Christian church is duty-bound to exclude such persons by the keys of the kingdom of heaven until they show amendment of life.

category_tet: Lalehan nia Reinu nia Xave Sira
question_tet: Saida mak lalehan nia reinu nia xave sira?
question_en: What are the keys of the kingdom of heaven?
answer_tet: Pregasaun evanjellu santu nian no disiplina kristaun ka exkomuñaun hosi kireja kristaun. Liuhosi meius rua ne'e lalehan nia reinu hetan loke ba ema fiar-sira no taka hasoru ema la fiar sira.
answer_en: The preaching of the holy gospel and Christian discipline or excommunication from the Christian church. By these two the kingdom of heaven is opened to believers and shut against unbelievers.

question_tet: Oinsá mak lalehan nia reinu hetan loke no taka liuhosi pregasaun evanjellu santu nian?
question_en: How is the kingdom of heaven opened and shut by the preaching of the holy gospel?
answer_tet: Tuir Kristu nia ukun-fuan, hetan proklama no fó sasin públiku ba ema fiar hotu-hotu no kualker ida, katak beibeik bainhira sira simu evanjellu nia promesa liuhosi fiar loloos, sira-nia sala sira hotu-hotu hetan perdua loloos hosi Maromak tanba Kristu nia mehi; no iha enkontráriu, hetan proklama no fó sasin ba ema la fiar no ipókrita hotu-hotu, katak Maromak nia hirus no kondenasaun eternu hela iha sira nia leten tantu tempu ne'ebé sira la arrepender. Tuir sasin evanjellu nian ne'e, Maromak sei tesi-lia ba sira tantu iha moris ne'e no iha moris ne'ebé atu mai.
answer_en: According to the command of Christ, it is proclaimed and publicly testified to all and every believer, that whenever they receive the promise of the gospel by true faith, all their sins are really forgiven them of God for the sake of Christ's merits; and on the contrary, it is proclaimed and testified to all unbelievers and hypocrites, that the wrath of God and eternal condemnation rest upon them as long as they do not repent. According to this testimony of the gospel, God will judge them both in this life and in that which is to come.

question_tet: Oinsá mak lalehan nia reinu hetan taka no loke liuhosi disiplina kristaun nian?
question_en: How is the kingdom of heaven shut and opened by Christian discipline?
answer_tet: Tuir Kristu nia ukun-fuan, se ema ruma iha ema kristaun nia naran okos kaer doutrina la kristaun ka lori moris la kristaun, no depoiz hosi avizu maun-alin nian beibeik recusar atu fila hosi sira-nia erru no dalan aat sira, sira hetan relata ba kireja ka ba sira-ne'ebé hetan hatato'o ba mehi ne'e hosi kireja. Se sira la evita sira-nia erru no dalan aat sira mós depoiz hosi avizu ne'e, sira hetan exklui liuhosi reteni sakramentu sira hosi kongregasaun kristaun, no hosi Maromak rasik hosi Kristu nia reinu; no se sira prometu no hatudu konversasaun loloos, sira hetan simu fali nu'udar membru sira hosi Kristu no Ninia kireja.
answer_en: According to the command of Christ, if any under the name of a Christian maintain unchristian doctrines or lead unchristian lives, and after repeated brotherly admonitions refuse to turn from their errors and evil ways, they are reported to the church or to those appointed for that purpose by the church. If they do not avoid their errors and evil ways even after this admonition, they are by them excluded through the withholding of the sacraments from the Christian congregation, and by God himself from the kingdom of Christ; and if they promise and show real amendment, they are again received as members of Christ and his church.

question_tet: Tanba ita hetan redensaun hosi ita-nia mizeria liuhosi grasa tanba Kristu la ho ita-nia mehi merese ruma, tanba saida mak ita tenke halo hahalok di'ak sira?
question_en: Since we are redeemed from our misery by grace through Christ without any merit of ours, why must we do good works?
answer_tet: Tanba Kristu, redime tiha ita ho Ninia ran, mós renova ita liuhosi Ninia Espíritu Santu tuir Ninia imajen rasik, atu nune'i ho ita-nia moris tomak ita hatudu ita-nia an agradesitu ba Maromak ba Ninia benefísiu sira, no Nia bele hetan hahi'i liuhosi ita; liután ne'e, atu ita rasik bele hetan garantia kona-ba ita-nia fiar liuhosi ninia ai-fuan sira, no liuhosi ita-nia moris devotu ita-nia prosimu sira mós bele hetan manán ba Kristu.
answer_en: Because Christ, having redeemed us by his blood, also renews us by his Holy Spirit after his own image, so that with our whole life we show ourselves thankful to God for his benefits, and he may be praised through us; further, that we ourselves may be assured of our faith by its fruits, and that by our godly walk our neighbors may also be won for Christ.

question_tet: Ema sira-ne'ebé la fila ba Maromak hosi sira-nia moris la fó agradesimentu no la arrepender bele hetan salvasaun ka?
question_en: Can those be saved who do not turn to God from their ungrateful and impenitent walk?
answer_tet: Lae mehi ida; tanba Escritura dehan katak laiha ema kasta-laek, idolatriu, adultériu, na'ok-dook, ema kaan-mát, hemu-boet, ho aat-ibun, ka na'ok-tebes sei herdeiro lalehan nia reinu.
answer_en: By no means; for the Scripture says that no unchaste person, idolater, adulterer, thief, covetous man, drunkard, slanderer, robber, or the like shall inherit the kingdom of God.

question_tet: Saida mak envolve iha arrepender ka konversasaun loloos?
question_en: What is involved in genuine repentance or conversion?
answer_tet: Buat tolu/rua: mate hosi ema tuan, no moris foun hosi ema foun.
answer_en: Two things: the dying of the old man, and the coming to life of the new.

question_tet: Saida mak mate hosi ema tuan?
question_en: What is the dying of the old man?
answer_tet: Tristeza laran tomak katak ita halo ofensa ba Maromak liuhosi ita-nia sala sira, no tan no tan odiu sira no halai hosi sira.
answer_en: Heartfelt sorrow that we have offended God by our sins, and more and more to hate them and flee from them.

question_tet: Saida mak moris hosi ema foun?
question_en: What is the coming to life of the new man?
answer_tet: Ksolok laran tomak iha Maromak liuhosi Kristu, no domin ho ksolok atu moris tuir Maromak nia hakarak iha hahalok di'ak hotu-hotu.
answer_en: Heartfelt joy in God through Christ, and a love and delight to live according to the will of God in all good works.

question_tet: Saida mak hahalok di'ak sira?
question_en: What are good works?
answer_tet: Sira-ne'ebé de'it mak hetan halo hosi fiar loloos, tuir Maromak nia lei, no ba Ninia glória; no la'ós sira-ne'ebé mehi hetan fundasaun iha ita-nia hanoin rasik ka iha ema nia tradisaun sira.
answer_en: Only those which are done out of true faith, conformable to God's law, and to his glory; and not such as are founded on our own opinion or the precepts of men.

question_tet: Saida mak Maromak nia lei?
question_en: What is the law of God?
answer_tet:
Maromak ko'alia liafuan sira-ne'e hotu, dehan: 'Ha'u mak Na'i ó-nia Maromak, ne'ebé lori ó sai hosi rai Ejiptu, hosi uma atan nian.
1. Ó keta iha maromak seluk sira iha Ha'u-nia oin.
2. Ó keta halo ba ó an imajen estátua nian...
3. Ó keta lori Na'i ó-nia Maromak nia naran ho leet...
4. Ó hanoin-hetan loron sábadu, atu halo nia santu...
5. Ó hamtauk no hahi'i ó-nia aman no ó-nia inan...
6. Ó keta oho.
7. Ó keta halo adultériu.
8. Ó keta na'ok.
9. Ó keta fó sasin falsu hasoru ó-nia prosimu.
10. Ó keta kaan ó-nia prosimu nia uma...'
answer_en:
God spake all these words, saying: 'I am the LORD thy God, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
1. Thou shalt have no other gods before me.
2. Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image...
3. Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain...
4. Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy...
5. Honor thy father and thy mother...
6. Thou shalt not kill.
7. Thou shalt not commit adultery.
8. Thou shalt not steal.
9. Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbor.
10. Thou shalt not covet thy neighbor's house...'

question_tet: Oinsá mak ukun-fuan sira-ne'e hetan fahe?
question_en: How are these commandments divided?
answer_tet: Ba iha tabela rua: dahuluk hanorin ita oinsá ita tenke moris iha relasaun ho Maromak; daruak, dever sira-ne'ebé ita tenke ba ita-nia prosimu.
answer_en: Into two tables: the first of which teaches us how we ought to conduct ourselves towards God; the second, what duties we owe to our neighbor.

question_tet: Saida mak Na'i husu iha ukun-fuan dahuluk?
question_en: What does the LORD require in the first commandment?
answer_tet: Atu ha'u, iha ta'uk atu lakon ha'u-nia klamar nia salvasaun, avoids no halai hosi idolatriu hotu-hotu, si'ik no serimónia mehi aat sira, inyoka santu sira ka kriatura seluk sira; no loloos komprende Maromak mesak ida de'it; fiar iha Nia mesak de'it; ho humildade no pasiénsia hotu-hotu hein buas di'ak sira hotu hosi Nia mesak de'it; no hadomi, hamtauk, no hahi'i Nia ho ha'u-nia fuan tomak, to'o ha'u pronta husik kriatura hotu-hotu duké halo buat kualker ida hasoru Ninia hakarak.
answer_en: That I, as dear as I value the salvation of my soul, avoid and flee from all idolatry, sorcery, superstitious rites, invocation of saints, or any other creatures; and rightly acknowledge the only true God; trust in him alone; with all humility and patience expect all good from him only; and love, fear, and honor him with my whole heart, so as rather to renounce all creatures than do the least thing against his will.

question_tet: Saida mak idolatriu?
question_en: What is idolatry?
answer_tet: Idolatriu mak inventa ka iha, iha Maromak mesak loloos ne'ebé revelar tiha Ninia an iha Ninia Liafuan nia fatin ka sekunda ho Nia, buat seluk ruma ne'ebé ema fiar ka ba ne'ebé ema tau ninia konfiansa.
answer_en: Idolatry is instead of the one true God who has revealed himself in his Word, or along with him, to conceive or have something else whereon to place one's trust.

question_tet: Saida mak Maromak husu iha ukun-fuan daruak?
question_en: What does God require in the second commandment?
answer_tet: Atu ita keta halo imajen ruma kona-ba Maromak iha mehi ka reprezentasaun seluk ruma, nem adora Nia ho dalan seluk ruma duké ne'ebé Nia hatato'o tiha iha Ninia Liafuan.
answer_en: That we in no wise make any image of God, nor worship him in any other way than he has commanded in his Word.

question_tet: Ita la tenke halo imajen ida kualker ka?
question_en: Should we then not make any images at all?
answer_tet: Maromak la bele no la tenke hetan reprezentasaun ho dalan ruma iha forma visível. Kona-ba kriatura sira, maski sira bele hetan pintar ka sculpir, maibé Maromak proibí halo ka iha sira-nia imajen sira atu adora sira ka uza sira ba Ninia servisu.
answer_en: God cannot nor may be in any way represented by images. But as for creatures, though they may be represented, yet God forbids to make or have their images, to worship them, or serve God by them.

question_tet: Maibé imajen sira la bele hetan toleránsia iha kireja sira nu'udar 'livru ba ema baibain' ka?
question_en: But may not images be tolerated in the churches as "books for the laity"?
answer_tet: Lae, tanba ita la tenke sai matanek liu Maromak, ne'ebé la hakarak Ninia kireja hetan hanorin liuhosi estátua mudo sira, maibé liuhosi pregasaun moris hosi Ninia Liafuan.
answer_en: No, for we ought not to be wiser than God, who will not have his church taught by dumb idols, but by the lively preaching of his Word.

question_tet: Saida mak hetan husu iha ukun-fuan datolu?
question_en: What is required in the third commandment?
answer_tet: Atu ita keta profana ka abuzu Maromak nia naran liuhosi juramentu ho malisan ka juramentu falsu, nem liuhosi juramentu la nesezáriu; mós atu keta sai partisipante iha sala aat sira-ne'e liuhosi nonook ka haree de'it; maibé atu uza Maromak nia naran santu ho ta'uk no respeitu de'it, atu nune'i Nia bele hetan konfesa loloos, hetan bolu iha orasaun, no hetan hahi'i iha ita-nia liafuan no hahalok hotu-hotu.
answer_en: That we, not only by cursing or perjury, but also by rash swearing, must not profane or abuse the name of God; nor make ourselves partakers of these horrible sins in others by silence or connivance; but that we use the holy name of God no otherwise than with fear and reverence; so that he may be rightly confessed and worshipped by us, and be glorified in all our words and works.

question_tet: Profanasaun hosi Maromak nia naran liuhosi juramentu no malisan mak sala todan tebes to'o Ninia hirus lakan hasoru sira mós ne'ebé la ajuda ho kbiit to'o bele atu previne no proibí nia ka?
question_en: Is the profaning of God's name by swearing and cursing so grievous a sin that his wrath is kindled against those also who do not help as much as they can to prevent and forbid it?
answer_tet: Certeza tebes, tanba laiha sala ida ne'ebé boot liu ka fakar Maromak nia hirus liu duké profanasaun hosi Ninia naran. Tan ne'e Nia ukun tiha katak sala ne'e tenke hetan kastigu ho mate.
answer_en: Certainly, for there is no sin greater or more provoking to God than the profaning of his name. Wherefore he has also commanded this sin to be punished with death.

question_tet: Ita bele juramentu ho relijiozu ho Maromak nia naran ka?
question_en: May we then swear religiously by the name of God?
answer_tet: Loos, bainhira autoridade husu nia, ka kuandu nesezidade husu atu mantesa no promosaun hosi fiar-metin no lia-loos, ba Maromak nia glória no ita-nia prosimu nia di'ak; tanba juramentu nune'i hetan fundasaun iha Maromak nia Liafuan, no tan ne'e hetan uza loloos hosi santu sira iha Testamentu Tuan no Foun.
answer_en: Yes, when the magistrate requires it, or necessity requires it to maintain and promote fidelity and truth, to God's glory and our neighbor's good; for such swearing is grounded in God's Word, and therefore was rightly used by the saints in the Old and New Testaments.

question_tet: Ita bele juramentu mós liuhosi santu sira ka kriatura seluk ruma ka?
question_en: May we also swear by saints or any other creature?
answer_tet: Lae, tanba juramentu loloos mak invocasaun ida ba Maromak, nu'udar ne'ebé hatene de'it fuan, katak Nia sei fó sasin ba lia-loos, no kastigu ha'u se ha'u juramentu falsu; honra ne'e la merese fó ba kriatura ida kualker.
answer_en: No, for a lawful oath is a calling upon God, as the only searcher of hearts, to bear witness to the truth, and to punish me if I swear falsely; which honor is due to no creature.

question_tet: Saida mak Maromak husu iha ukun-fuan dafaat?
question_en: What does God require in the fourth commandment?
answer_tet: Dahuluk, katak ninia ministériu evanjellu nian no eskola sira hetan mantesa; no katak ha'u, liuliu iha loron descanso nian, frequenta ho matan-moris Maromak nia kireja, atu rona Maromak nia Liafuan, uzu sakramentu sira, reza públiku ba Na'i, no fó esmola ba ema ki'ak sira. Daruak, katak moris tomak ha'u descansa hosi ha'u-nia servisu aat sira, laga Na'i servisu liuhosi Ninia Espíritu iha ha'u laran, no nune'i hahuu iha moris ne'e sábadu eternu.
answer_en: First, that the ministry of the gospel and the schools be maintained; and that I, especially on the sabbath day, diligently attend the church of God, to hear the Word of God, to use the sacraments, to call publicly upon the Lord, and to give Christian alms. Second, that all the days of my life I rest from my evil works, let the Lord work by his Spirit in me, and so begin in this life the eternal sabbath.

question_tet: Saida mak Maromak husu iha ukun-fuan dalima?
question_en: What does God require in the fifth commandment?
answer_tet: Atu ha'u hatudu onra, domin, no fiar-metin hotu-hotu ba ha'u-nia aman no inan, no ba sira hotu-hotu ne'ebé iha autoridade iha ha'u-nia leten; submete ha'u-nia an ho obediénsia nurensa ba sira-nia ensinu di'ak no korresaun sira; no mós iha pasiénsia ho sira-nia frakeza sira, tanba Maromak nia hakarak mak atu ukun ita liuhosi sira-nia lima.
answer_en: That I show all honor, love, and fidelity to my father and mother and to all in authority over me; submit myself with due obedience to their good instruction and correction; and also have patience with their weaknesses, since it pleases God to govern us by their hand.

question_tet: Saida mak Maromak husu iha ukun-fuan daneen?
question_en: What does God require in the sixth commandment?
answer_tet: Atu ha'u la desonra, odiu, ameasas, ka oho ha'u-nia prosimu, liuhosi ha'u-nia an rasik ka liuhosi ema seluk, iha hanoin, liafuan, jestu, ka hahalok; maibé husik soe hakarak vingansa nian hotu-hotu; mós atu keta mance ha'u-nia an rasik ka lori ha'u-nia an nune'i ho perigu ba perigu; tan ne'e mós autoridade kaer surik atu previne oho nian.
answer_en: That I neither dishonor, hate, injure, nor kill my neighbor, whether by thoughts, words, gestures, or deeds, much less by actual deed, either in myself or by another; but lay aside all desire of revenge; also that I do not harm myself or willfully expose myself to danger; for which cause also the magistrate is armed with the sword to prevent murder.

question_tet: Maibé ukun-fuan ne'e haree nu'udar ko'alia de'it kona-ba oho nian ka?
question_en: But this commandment seems to speak only of murder?
answer_tet: Iha proibí oho nian, Maromak hanorin ita katak Nia odiu amutansa hosi oho nian, ne'e mak imveja, odiu, hirus, no hakarak vingansa nian; no buat sira-ne'e hotu ne'ebé consideran nu'udar oho subar.
answer_en: In forbidding murder, God teaches us that he hates the root of murder, namely envy, hatred, anger, and desire of revenge; and that all these are in his sight hidden murder.

question_tet: Se nune'i sufisiente atu ita keta oho ita-nia prosimu ho dalan sira-ne'e ka?
question_en: Is it enough then that we do not kill our neighbor in any such way?
answer_tet: Lae; tanba bainhira Maromak kondena imveja, odiu, no hirus, Nia husu ita atu hadomi ita-nia prosimu hanesan ita-nia an rasik; hatudu pasiénsia, dame, koldura, misericórdia, no amizade ba nia; previne ninia aat to'o ita bele; no halo di'ak mós ba ita-nia inimigu sira.
answer_en: No; for when God condemns envy, hatred, and anger, he requires us to love our neighbor as ourselves; to show patience, peace, gentleness, mercy, and friendliness toward him; to prevent his harm as much as in us lies; and to do good even to our enemies.

question_tet: Saida mak ukun-fuan daseitu hanorin ita?
question_en: What does the seventh commandment teach us?
answer_tet: Katak aat-isun hotu-hotu hetan malisan hosi Maromak; no tan ne'e ita tenke odiu nia ho laran tomak, no moris kasta no matan-moris, tantu iha kaben laran ka iha moris solteiru.
answer_en: That all unchastity is accursed of God; and that we should therefore deeply hate it, and live chastely and modestly, whether in holy wedlock or in single life.

question_tet: Maromak proibí iha ukun-fuan ne'e la'ós buat seluk duké adultériu no sala aat tebes sira-ne'e ka?
question_en: Does God forbid in this commandment nothing more than adultery and such gross sins?
