answer_tet: Tanba isin no klamar rua ne'e mak Maromak no Espíritu Santu nia tempulu sira, Maromak hakarak ita atu preserva sintu rua ne'e ho kasta no santu; tan ne'e Nia proibí hahalok, jestu, liafuan, hanoin, mehi aat aat-isun nian hotu-hotu, no buat hotu-hotu ne'ebé bele dada ema ba ne'e.
answer_en: Since both our body and soul are temples of the Holy Spirit, God wills that we keep both pure and holy; for which cause he forbids all unchaste actions, gestures, words, thoughts, desires, and whatever may entice thereto.

question_tet: Saida mak Maromak proibí iha ukun-fuan daualu?
question_en: What does God forbid in the eighth commandment?
answer_tet: Maromak proibí la'ós de'it na'ok no foti liuhosi kbiit ne'ebé autoridade sivil kastigu; maibé mós Nia bolu na'ok pratika aat no husu hotu-hotu liuhosi ne'ebé ita ho mehi aat foti ita-nia prosimu nia rikusoin ba ita an rasik, se liuhosi violénsia ka subar hosi jusustisa, hanesan osan falsu, medikasaun falsu, mezu falsu, marsiandaria falsu, juros aat, ka meius seluk ruma ne'ebé Maromak proibí; liután ne'e Nia proibí kaan-mát hotu-hotu no abuzu no soe sa'e hosi Ninia dom sira.
answer_en: God forbids not only such theft and robbery as are punished by the magistrate; but he also calls theft all wicked tricks and devices whereby we aim to appropriate to ourselves our neighbor's goods, whether by force or under pretext of right, as unjust weights, measures, fraud, counterfeit money, usury, or any means forbidden of God; additionally he forbids all covetousness and all abuse and waste of his gifts.

question_tet: Saida mak Maromak husu mai ita iha ukun-fuan ne'e?
question_en: What does God require of us in this commandment?
answer_tet: Atu ha'u promove ha'u-nia prosimu nia benefísiu to'o ha'u bele, mehi lori sira ho dalan ne'ebé ha'u hakarak sira lori ha'u; no liután ne'e, ha'u servisu ho matan-moris atu nune'i ha'u bele ajuda ema ki'ak sira iha sira-nia nesezidade.
answer_en: That I promote my neighbor's benefit as much as I can, dealing with him as I would wish others to deal with me; and further, that I work faithfully so that I may be able to help the needy in their necessity.

question_tet: Saida mak hetan husu iha ukun-fuan dasia?
question_en: What is required in the ninth commandment?
answer_tet: Atu ha'u keta fó sasin falsu hasoru ema ruma, nem foti liafuan sira la loloos; keta sai abusu-nain ka aat-ibun, nem kondena ka ajuda kondena ema ruma ho la rona no ho la juzgu; maibé halai hosi bosok no enganu hotu-hotu nu'udar diabu nia hahalok rasik, okos hosi Maromak nia hirus todan; mós iha juízu no procesus hotu-hotu ama no konfesa lia-loos ho hakarak livre, no defende no promove ha'u-nia prosimu nia honor no naran di'ak to'o ha'u bele.
answer_en: That I bear false witness against no man, nor falsify any man's words; be no slanderer or backbiter, nor condemn or join in condemning any man rashly and unheard; but avoid all lying and deceit as the proper works of the devil, under the heavy wrath of God; also that in judgment and all other actions I love, speak, and confess the truth uprightly, and defend and promote my neighbor's honor and reputation as much as I can.

question_tet: Saida mak hetan husu iha ukun-fuan dakumi?
question_en: What is required in the tenth commandment?
answer_tet: Atu la husik sekunda mós sirkunsia mehi oituan husi hanoin ka hakarak aat sira hasoru Maromak nia ukun-fuan sira tama iha ita-nia fuan; maibé atu ita nafatin odiu sala hotu-hotu ho fuan tomak no iha ksolok iha justisa hotu-hotu.
answer_en: That even the least inclination or thought against any commandment of God never enter into our heart; but that with our whole heart we at all times hate all sin and have a delight in all righteousness.

category_tet: Lei nia Perfeisaun no Ema nia Frakeza
question_tet: Ema sira-ne'ebé fila tiha ba Maromak bele kumpri perfeitu ukun-fuan sira-ne'e ka?
question_en: Can those who are converted to God keep these commandments perfectly?
answer_tet: Lae; maibé sira-ne'ebé ho mehi aat liu hotu iha moris ne'e iha de'it hahuu ki'ik ida hosi obediénsia ne'e; ne'e maski nune'i, sira iha propozitu seriu no fuan tomak hahuu atu moris la'ós de'it tuir balun maibé tuir Maromak nia ukun-fuan hotu-hotu.
answer_en: No; but even the holiest men, while in this life, have only a small beginning of this obedience; yet so, that with a serious purpose they begin to live not only according to some, but according to all the commandments of God.

question_tet: Tanba saida mak Maromak se nune'i haruka Ukun-Fuan Sanulu hetan pregasa soe-an tebes, bainhira laiha ema ida iha moris ne'e ne'ebé bele kumpri sira?
question_en: Why then does God suffer the Ten Commandments to be so strictly preached, since no one in this life can keep them?
answer_tet: Dahuluk, atu durante ita-nia moris tomak ita bele hatene tan no tan ita-nia natureza sala nian, no nune'i ho matan-moris liu buka perdua sala nian no justisa iha Kristu; daruak, atu ita fakar ita-nia an beibeik no husu Maromak nia grasa Espíritu Santu nian atu hetan renova tan no tan tuir Maromak nia imajen, to'o ita to'o meta perfeisaun nian depoiz moris ne'e.
answer_en: First, that all our life long we may learn more and more to know our sinful nature, and so the more earnestly seek forgiveness of sins and righteousness in Christ; second, that we may continually exert ourselves and pray to God for the grace of the Holy Spirit, that we may become more and more renewed after the image of God, until we attain the goal of perfection after this life.

question_tet: Tanba saida mak orasaun nesezáriu ba ema kristaun sira?
question_en: Why is prayer necessary for Christians?
answer_tet: Tanba nia mak parte prinsipál hosi agradesimentu ne'ebé Maromak husu hosi ita; no mós tanba Maromak kunsede Ninia grasa no Espíritu Santu ba sira-ne'ebé husu sira ho mehi fuan tomak no agradesimentu no haruik an beibeik ba Nia.
answer_en: Because it is the chief part of thankfulness which God requires of us; and also because God will give his grace and Holy Spirit only to those who with heartfelt longing continually ask them of him and render thanks for them.

question_tet: Saida mak pertenc ba orasaun nune'i ne'ebé haksolok Maromak no hetan rona hosi Nia?
question_en: What belongs to such a prayer as pleases God and is heard by him?
answer_tet: Dahuluk, atu ita invocasaun hosi fuan Maromak mesak loloos ne'ebé revelar tiha Ninia an mai ita iha Ninia Liafuan ba buat hotu-hotu ne'ebé Nia ukun tiha ita atu husu; daruak, atu ita komprende loloos ita-nia nesezidade no mizeria, atu nune'i ita bele haraik an iha Ninia majestade santu nia oin; datolu, atu ita iha fundasaun metin ne'e katak Nia, la ho ita-nia mehi merese ida, sei rona ita-nia orasaun tanba Jesuis Kristu nia mehi, hanesan Nia prometu tiha mai ita iha Ninia Liafuan.
answer_en: First, that we from the heart call upon the one true God only, who has revealed himself to us in his Word, for all that he has commanded us to ask of him; second, that we thoroughly know our need and misery, so that we may humble ourselves before his divine majesty; third, that we have this firm foundation, that he, for the sake of Christ our Lord, will certainly hear our prayer, calculated though we are to be unworthy, as he has promised us in his Word.

question_tet: Saida mak Maromak ukun tiha ita atu husu hosi Nia?
question_en: What has God commanded us to ask of him?
answer_tet: Buat hotu-hotu ne'ebé nesezáriu ba isin no klamar, ne'ebé Na'i Jesuis Kristu mehi subsumi iha orasaun ne'ebé Nia hanorin ita rasik.
answer_en: All things necessary for body and soul, which Christ our Lord has comprised in the prayer which he himself taught us.

question_tet: Orasaun ne'e mak saida?
question_en: What is that prayer?

question_tet: Tanba saida mak Kristu ukun tiha ita atu hakbesik Maromak nu'udar "Ita-nia Aman"?
question_en: Why has Christ commanded us to address God as "Our Father"?
answer_tet: Atu foti iha ita, iha hahuu loloos hosi ita-nia orasaun, respeitu mehi fuan tihan no konfiansa oan nian ba Maromak, ne'ebé tenke sai fundasaun hosi ita-nia orasaun; ne'e mak katak Maromak sai tiha ita-nia Aman liuhosi Kristu, no sei la nega mai ita buat ne'ebé ita husu ho fiar duké ita-nia mehi aman sira nega buat di'ak sira ba sira-nia oan sira.
answer_en: That at the very beginning of our prayer he might excite in us a childlike reverence and trust toward God, which are to be the ground of our prayer; namely, that God has become our Father through Christ, and will much less deny us what we ask of him in faith than our parents refuse us earthly things.

question_tet: Tanba saida mak aumenta liafuan sira-ne'e: "Ne'ebé iha lalehan"?
question_en: Why is there added: "Who art in heaven"?
answer_tet: Atu ita keta iha hanoin rai nian kona-ba Maromak nia majestade lalehan nian, no atu ita hein hosi Ninia kbiit Kbiit-Na'in buat hotu-hotu ne'ebé nesezáriu ba ita-nia isin no klamar.
answer_en: That we may not have an earthly thought of the heavenly majesty of God, and may expect from his almighty power all things necessary for body and soul.

question_tet: Saida mak petisaun dahuluk?
question_en: What is the first petition?
answer_tet: "Santu kaer Ó-nia naran"; ne'e mak: Kapasita ita dahuluk atu hatene Ó loloos, no atu santifika, hahi'i, no fó glória ba Ó iha Ó-nia obra hotu-hotu, iha ne'ebé Ó-nia kbiit, matanek, di'ak, justisa, misericórdia, no lia-loos hatudu sai ho nabilan; mós duni dirije ita-nia moris tomak, iha hanoin, liafuan, no hahalok, atu nune'i Ó-nia naran keta hetan profana maibé hetan honra no hahi'i tan ita.
answer_en: "Hallowed be thy name"; that is: Grant us first, rightly to know thee, and to hallow, magnify, and praise thee in all thy works, in which thy power, wisdom, goodness, justice, mercy, and truth shine forth; also that we may so order our whole life, in thoughts, words, and deeds, that thy name may not be blasphemed, but honored and praised on our account.

question_tet: Saida mak petisaun daruak?
question_en: What is the second petition?
answer_tet: "Ó-nia Reinu mai"; ne'e mak: Ukun ita nune'i liuhosi Ó-nia Liafuan no Espíritu, atu ita submite ita an tan no tan ba Ó; preserva no haboot Ó-nia kireja; harat diabu nia obra sira hotu-hotu, kualker podér ne'ebé foti an hasoru Ó, no konsellu aat sira hotu-hotu ne'ebé excogita hasoru Ó-nia Liafuan santu; to'o perfeisaun hosi Ó-nia reinu to'o, iha ne'ebé Ó sei sai buat hotu-hotu iha ema hotu-hotu laran.
answer_en: "Thy kingdom come"; that is: Rule us so by thy Word and Spirit, that we may submit ourselves more and more to thee; preserve and increase thy church; destroy the works of the devil, every power that exalts itself against thee, and all wicked counsels conceived against thy holy Word; until the perfection of thy kingdom come, wherein thou shalt be all in all.

question_tet: Saida mak petisaun datolu?
question_en: What is the third petition?
answer_tet: "Ó-nia hakarak hetan halo iha rai hanesan iha lalehan"; ne'e mak: Kapasita ita no ema hotu-hotu atu nega ita-nia hakarak rasik, no ho la kontradisaun ruma obedese Ó-nia hakarak, ne'ebé mak hahuu mesak di'ak; atu nune'i kualker ema bele hala'o ninia dever ho mehi fiar-metin no voluntáriu hanesan anju sira halo iha lalehan.
answer_en: "Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven"; that is: Grant that we and all men may renounce our own will, and without any gainsaying obey thy will, which alone is good; that so everyone may fulfill his office and calling as willingly and faithfully as the angels do in heaven.

question_tet: Saida mak petisaun dafaat?
question_en: What is the fourth petition?
answer_tet: "Fó mai ita loron ne'e ita-nia paun loron-loron nian"; ne'e mak: Beik sira atu providensia ami ho nesezidade temporál sira hotu-hotu, atu nune'i ami bele komprende katak Ó mak fonte mesak hosi buat di'ak hotu-hotu, no katak nem ami-nia kuidadu ka esfuersu sira, nem Ó-nia dom sira la benefisia ami la ho Ó-nia bensan; no tan ne'e atu ami bele foti ami-nia konfiansa hosi kriatura hotu-hotu no tau nia iha Ó mesak de'it.
answer_en: "Give us this day our daily bread"; that is: Be pleased to provide us with all things necessary for the body, that we may thereby acknowledge thee to be the only fountain of all good, and that neither our care and industry, nor thy gifts, can profit us without thy blessing; and that we may therefore withdraw our trust from all creatures and place it in thee alone.

question_tet: Saida mak petisaun dalima?
question_en: What is the fifth petition?
answer_tet: "Perdua ita-nia dívida sira, hanesan ita perdua ita-nia deve-na'in sira"; ne'e mak: Beik sira atu, tanba Kristu nia ran, keta imputa mai ami pekadór coitadu sira ami-nia mehi aat sira hotu-hotu, nem aat ne'ebé naklahat nafatin iha ami laran; hanesan ami mós sente sasin ne'e hosi Ó-nia grasa iha ami laran, katak ami-nia intensaun firmi mak atu perdua ami-nia prosimu ho fuan tomak.
answer_en: "And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors"; that is: Be pleased for the sake of Christ's blood, not to impute to us, poor sinners, our transgressions, nor that depravity which always cleaves to us; even as we also feel this witness of thy grace in us, that it is our firm purpose heartily to forgive our neighbor.

question_tet: Saida mak petisaun daneen?
question_en: What is the sixth petition?
answer_tet: "Keta lori ita ba tentasaun, maibé liberta ita hosi aat"; ne'e mak: Tanba ami iha ami-nia an rasik fraku tebes to'o ami la bele hamriik firme sekundu ida de'it, bainhira ami-nia inimigu moris aat sira—diabu, mundu, no ami-nia isin rasik—la cease ataqa ami; beik sira atu sustenta no hametin ami liuhosi Ó-nia Espíritu Santu nia podér, atu ami keta monu iha funu espíritu nian ne'e, maibé hamriik firme atu tahan nurensa to'o ami ikusmai hetan vitória tomak.
answer_en: "And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil"; that is: Since we are in ourselves so weak that we cannot stand even for a moment, while our sworn enemies—the devil, the world, and our own flesh—cease not to assail us; be pleased to uphold and strengthen us by the power of thy Holy Spirit, that we may not sink in this spiritual combat, but stand firm until we finally obtain a complete victory.

question_tet: Oinsá mak ó taka ó-nia orasaun?
question_en: How do you conclude your prayer?
answer_tet: "Tanba Reinu, no podér, no glória mak Ó-nian ba nafatin"; ne'e mak: Ami petisaun buat sira-ne'e hotu hosi Ó tanba Ó, nu'udar ami-nia Liurai Kbiit-Na'in, iha hakarak no kbiit atu fó mai ami buat di'ak sira hotu-hotu; no ne'e ami halo atu nune'i la'ós ami, maibé Ó-nia naran santu bele hetan fó glória ba nafatin.
answer_en: "For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, forever"; that is: All these things we ask of thee because thou, being our King Almighty, art willing and able to give us all good; and this we do in order that not we, but thy holy name may be glorified forever.

question_tet: Saida mak significadu hosi liafuan "Ámen"?
question_en: What is the meaning of the word "Amen"?
answer_tet: "Ámen" significa: Ne'e sei sai tebes no lo-loos! Tanba ha'u-nia orasaun hetan rona hosi Maromak ho garantia boot liu duké ha'u sente iha ha'u-nia fuan katak ha'u deseja buat sira-ne'e hosi Nia.
answer_en: "Amen" signifies: It shall truly and certainly be! For my prayer is far more certainly heard of God than I feel in my heart that I desire these things of him.
